clients.name: Tess Abara
clients.title: the union's dock steward
clients.blurb: Keeps the union's books at every dock on the run, and its grievances. Pays in cash, eventually.

clients.name: Old Brannigan
clients.title: a retired hull rigger
clients.blurb: Forty years on a tether, hanging off hulls. Knows every berth on the run and who still owes for it.

clients.name: Purser Hask
clients.title: a Company purser
clients.blurb: Signs for every crate that leaves a Con-Reg dock, and quietly for a few that don't.

clients.name: Assessor Venn
clients.title: the Company's claims assessor
clients.blurb: Prices the rocks for Con-Reg, and the people working them. Pays on the Company's paper.

clients.name: Lieutenant Dalca
clients.title: a Fleet supply officer
clients.blurb: Keeps the Fleet's stations stocked and her ledgers tidy, and doesn't ask how you managed either.

clients.name: Chief Moss
clients.title: the berthing chief
clients.blurb: Runs a Fleet station's berths like a ship's deck: on time, by the book, and with a little book of his own.

clients.name: Orla Halloran
clients.title: the family's purse on the run
clients.blurb: Lends to anyone at any station and collects from everyone. Smiles the whole time.

clients.name: Quill
clients.title: a Halloran fixer
clients.blurb: Finds what the family wants found and loses what it wants lost. Always at the next table.

clients.name: Hollis Rourke
clients.title: a freight broker
clients.blurb: Finds cargo for empty holds and holds for nervous cargo, at any station that'll let him dock.

clients.name: June Ostrova
clients.title: a rock hopper
clients.blurb: Works the claims nobody else wants, on rocks nobody charted. Pays in what she digs up, and in credits once it sells.

sites.name: the cargo ring
sites.blurb: Where the freighters dock and the crates change hands. Somebody always knows which crates.

sites.name: the fuel dock
sites.blurb: Fuel lines, pumps and a bulkhead between them and everyone else. No smoking, in theory.

sites.name: the Tumble
sites.blurb: The rocks off the station's docks, turning slow. Everybody's claim and nobody's.

sites.name: a worked-out claim
sites.blurb: A rock somebody mined hollow and left a shack on. Somebody else lives there now.
